Reservoir station training notes
The station stores clean water for a demonstration garden.
Its three components are the intake screen, reservoir, and outlet valve.
The intake screen catches leaves before water enters the reservoir.
The reservoir stores water. Its maximum capacity is 100 litres.
The outlet valve controls water flowing from the reservoir to the garden.
The amber indicator means the reservoir holds less than 20 litres.
The red indicator means the reservoir holds more than 80 litres.
The green indicator means the reservoir holds 20 through 80 litres.
To start the station, inspect the intake screen first.
Next, open the intake valve. Then fill the reservoir to 50 litres.
Finally, open the outlet valve to send water to the garden.
Inspect the screen every morning. Remove trapped leaves by hand.
Keep the outlet closed whenever the amber indicator is on.
Close the intake valve whenever the red indicator is on.
Record the reservoir level and indicator colour in the daily log.
